text: Would you take one million dollars right now <break time="0.4s" /> or one dollar that doubles every single day?
Day one, you get one dollar. Day two, two dollars. <break time="0.3s" /> Day three, four. And the pile of coins doubles in height every day.
After a whole week, you only have one hundred twenty-seven dollars. <break time="0.3s" /> A stack shorter than a ruler. Sounds like a terrible deal, right?
But now, stack those coins. By day ten, the tower is taller than a person. By day eighteen, it is taller than the Burj Khalifa. <break time="0.3s" /> And on day twenty, you pass one million dollars.
By day twenty-three, it is taller than Mount Everest. By day twenty-six, it reaches space. <break time="0.3s" /> And by day thirty, you have over one billion dollars.
So, would you still take the million? <break time="0.3s" /> Follow for more mind-blowing math.
